scope: Offline analysis of one future full-Matrix MOV only; generated synthetic inputs and generated output. No Resolve/source/config interaction.

matrixReadiness.facts: 1920x1080, 25 fps, 48 kHz, bounds 0..9200; conditional on fresh pair; no native dispatch/render. Historical preset PCM16 is ineligible; fresh render must verify PCM24.

reusablePath.detail: audio-output.py validates audio-only render setup/output metadata and av-output.py validates MOV/H264/lpcm PCM24 metadata. Existing source-timing analysis verifies generated WAV nonzero support. No retained comparator aligns rendered program PCM to expected generated-source windows or classifies omissions/residuals/offsets. The source-support report is reusable as expected-support evidence only.

allowedBinding.onlyGeneratedSource: Manifest-bound repeated.wav above; single-channel mono PCM16 generated source, 384000 samples at 48 kHz.
allowedBinding.frameMapping: 1920 samples/frame. Support starts are frame +10 samples; exclusive ends frame +1698 samples (222 samples before next frame). Occurrences spaced 96000 samples / 50 frames.
allowedBinding.expectedRecordAndSourceIntervals: Derive expected record positions only from a fresh, retained selected-Matrix before/after pair and editorial action evidence. Bind each audio item by exact source identity and source in/out to these four support intersections; map source sample offsets to record samples using verified speed and record start. A picture-only item contributes no expected audio. Preserve half-open intervals. Current available R2 timing notes describe linked Audio 1 0..199 frames at 100% while Video 1 retimes 0..99 source frames at 50%; they do not enumerate final per-word edited record intervals, so do not fabricate them.

classificationPlan.comparison: After native render exists and output is independently verified as 25fps/48kHz/24-bit PCM, decode only that generated MOV audio plus manifest-bound repeated.wav. For each evidence-derived expected record window, correlate normalized source waveform against output with bounded lag; report match score, best lag in samples, gain estimate, residual energy, and nonzero support intervals. Also inspect expected-empty/picture-only windows for residual program energy. Report linked, unlinked, picture-only, partial-support, residual, and offset labels as waveform observations tied to item bindings, not editorial truth.
classificationPlan.nextAction: After the authorized full-Matrix render completes, capture its output path/hash and exact final item bindings/record ranges from retained evidence; then implement/run a narrowly scoped offline comparator against repeated.wav and the single generated MOV. Until then no comparator run or output conclusion is possible.

limitations: No final word deletion may be inferred from timeline geometry or source support alone.
Routing, track mute/solo, bus behavior and output gain may make expected clips absent, mixed or scaled; retain level/gain evidence and do not equate silence with deletion.

PCM24 encoding and render alignment may produce rounding/filter/codec-edge differences; the existing support boundaries are source sample exact, not proof of sample-exact Resolve edits. State boundary tolerance empirically and in samples.
Residual energy may come from adjacent clips, fades, effects, noise floor or routing; inspect correlation and local residual, and label ambiguous results unresolved.
Do not access or hash protected semi1b.mp4.
